examples.arabic: بكرة هنروح أنا وأختي السوق علشان نشتري فاكهة طازة، ممكن نجيب أربع برتقالات كبار.
examples.english: Tomorrow, my sister and I will go to the market to buy fresh fruit; we might get four big oranges.
examples.transliteration: Bokra hanrooḥ ana we ʾokhty el sooʾ ʾalashan neshtry fakha taza, momken nigeeb ʾarbaʾ bortoqalat kobar.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

examples.arabic: هو شاف أصحابه علي ومنى جنب محل الفاكهة.
examples.english: He saw his friends Ali and Mona next to the fruit shop.
examples.transliteration: Howa shaf ashabo Ali w Mona gamb mahl el faka.

examples.english: I buy fresh fruit for the house
examples.transliteration: ana bashteri faka taza lel beit

examples.arabic: امي طلبت مني نشتري فاكهة وخضار من السوق الكبير
examples.english: My mother asked me to buy fruit and vegetables from the big market.
examples.transliteration: Ommy talabit minni neshtary fakha we khodaar men el soo' el kibeer.

examples.arabic: كان فيه ناس كتير والخضار والفاكهة مالية المكان
examples.english: There were many people, and vegetables and fruit filled the place.
examples.transliteration: Kaan fee naas keteer wal khodaar wal fak-ha malya el makan

examples.arabic: احنا بنحب ناكل فاكهة وخضار كتير هناك في بيت الرحلة
examples.english: We love to eat a lot of fruit and vegetables there at the trip house.
examples.transliteration: Ehna benhebb nakol fakha we khodaar kiteer henaak fi bayt el rehla
